title: REQ · Story Panel shows scene title and scrolls independently in pixel-art styling
summary: StoryPanel renders the current scene title with dialogue, choices, history and inventory in a self-scrolling pixel-styled container
description: Context: game/frontend/src/components/StoryPanel.tsx (L1-L47) renders dialogue, history and inventory but no scene title, and uses the unstyled 'story-content' class. Desired behavior: add a sceneTitle prop rendered as a heading, and wrap the content in a container that scrolls on its own with pixel-art Tailwind styling. Expected result: the panel shows all required story elements. Why: players need context for where they are.
acceptance_criteria: Given sceneTitle 'The Boys Room', when StoryPanel renders, then a heading with that text is shown
Given a container, when the history is long, then the container has overflow-y-auto and a bounded height so it scrolls independently
Given a dialogue node with two choices, when the second is clicked, then onChoose is called with 1
technical_constraints: Tailwind classes only; pixel font via existing design tokens
definition_of_done: StoryPanel renders scene title and scrolls independently
